properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 10 at 9:46PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Horse Creek near Arcadia at SR 72.

* WHEN...From Sunday morning until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The access road to Hidden Oak is
impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Thursday the stage was 7.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage Sunday
morning and continue rising to 12.2 feet Sunday evening.
Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 12.2
feet on 11/24/1997.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Friday afternoon at noon EDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT FROM SUNDAY MORNING UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE

properties.areaDesc: Pensacola Bay Area including Santa Rosa Sound; Coastal waters from Okaloosa-Walton County Line to Pensacola FL out 20 NM
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 11 at 5:59AM CDT until September 11 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
SMWMOB

The National Weather Service in Mobile has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Okaloosa-Walton County Line to Pensacola FL out
20 NM...
Pensacola Bay Area including Santa Rosa Sound...

* Until 700 AM CDT.

* At 559 AM CDT, strong thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from near
Blackwater Bay Bridge to 8 nm southeast of Pensacola Beach, moving
northeast at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Navarre Beach, West Santa Rosa Sound, Pensacola Beach, Escambia Bay
Bridge, Blackwater Bay Bridge, East Bay, Escambia Bay, Pensacola
Bay Bridge, and Garcon Point Bridge.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 11 at 5:02AM EDT until September 11 at 8:30AM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by prior excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Northern Jackson County in southeastern Ohio...

* WHEN...Until 830 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 500 AM EDT, emergency management reported lingering high water
across portions of the warned area from prior heavy rainfall last
evening. Flooding is already occurring.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Jackson, Wellston, Coalton and Byer.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Report flooding to the National Weather Service by calling toll free,
800 401 9535, when you can do so safely.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 830 AM EDT THIS MORNING
